title: SessionRevokedByPasswordChangePayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'session.revoked-by-password-change' (G5/F3, STATE.md 'Current-password re-auth on self-changes'). Emitted by packages/db/src/query/admin.ts's updateUserSelf whenever a successful self-service password change (PATCH /users/me) bulk-revokes every OTHER refresh token the user holds, in the SAME transaction as the revoke — envelope actorUserId = the user themself (they authenticated this exact request; the revoke is a direct, intended consequence of their own action, not an admin/CLI action on their behalf). ADMIN_ONLY delivery (apps/server/src/plugins/event-taxonomy.ts): this is instance-administration/audit activity, never granted to a plugin subscriber. Never carries a token or password hash.

revokedCount.description: How many other refresh tokens were revoked — the exact count revokeOtherRefreshTokensForUser's own UPDATE returned, never a separate COUNT query. The caller's OWN current-session refresh token (identified by the access token's deviceId claim) is excluded and therefore never counted here.
